sloka: धन्याः खलु महात्मानो मुनयस्त्यक्तकिल्बिषाः ।जितात्मानो महाभागा येषां न स्तः प्रियाप्रिये ।। ५.२६.४९।।।।
transliteration: dhanyāḥ khalu mahātmāno munayastyaktakilbiṣāḥ ।jitātmāno mahābhāgā yeṣāṁ na staḥ priyāpriye ।। 5.26.49।।।।

translations.english: Blessed are the exhalted sages who have not committed any sin. They have self control and have subdued their senses. There is no pleasure or displeasure for them.
